Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Currently enrolled within the "Getting Off" (AKA, "Friends Getting Off") outpatient methamphetamine treatment program  [AND] at Friends Community Center, Los Angeles, CA, USA

right.raw_text: -  and; within two weeks of initial enrollment into the "Getting Off" program

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Not  [OR] currently enrolled within the "Getting Off" program

right.raw_text: -  or; more than two weeks post-enrollment in the "Getting Off" program
